name: FEMA National Risk Index county hazard-type risk index scores
version_note: The ArcGIS item for this counties layer identified National Risk Index data version December 2025 (v1.20.0). Values in the CSV are the hazard-type risk index scores returned for the ten hub counties on 2026-11-23.
scale_note: These are FEMA's published 0-100 hazard-type risk index scores, used directly. A blank hurricane or coastal-flood cell means the service returned null. The scorer treats that unpublished cell as 0 and says so when that hazard is on screen.
